narrative: Resident Welfare Association Secretary sends a meeting reminder on WhatsApp.

message.body: Good evening all. Reminder: Annual General Meeting this Sunday at 10 AM in the Clubhouse. Agenda document is posted on the notice board.

evidence.label: Sender Contact
evidence.value: Saved contact of elected RWA Secretary

evidence.label: Message Content
evidence.value: Informational reminder; asks for no codes or payments

evidence.label: Official Society Notice Board
evidence.value: Physical notice board and society app show identical AGM schedule.

consequence_text.safe: You checked the society notice board and confirmed the upcoming meeting details.
consequence_text.unsafe: Rejecting authentic community reminders creates needless paranoia.

teaching_point: Informational messages from known contacts without sensitive requests are genuine.
